result: Gap test failed in every libniji process (pass 2), both hosts, never as a glibc process: its RLIMIT_AS figure was read before vm_size()'s own allocation, which maps 2 MiB of libniji heap on the thread's first malloc (ENOMEM, 3 pages short). Test fixed (non-allocating figure taken at the pin, limit exactly SEG + PAD); no heap defect.
head: 111418a7e
informational: Cause is the process kind, not load/NUMA/host: next fails 0/20 as a libniji process even pinned to one cpu or node; passes 20/20 native + 20/20 interposed as a glibc process (keke) and 60/60 (Skylake-SP); Skylake-SP xtask test fails it in pass 2 only.

HEAP-ADDRESS-SPACE-10 never ran the test in pass 2 (its 20/20 and plants were cargo test; its xtask test stopped at products). Recommend: plants on heap/address-space code run through affected --run (pass 2); s03 RLIMIT/gap tests in the train's pass 2 for heap changes.
affected --run runs pass 2 only for changes in mem/rt/kernel/abi/boundary; other branches never run this test in pass 2 in CI. Whether HEAP-10's CI pass 2 ran it was not checked.
libniji heap maps 2 MiB of address space on a new thread's first small allocation (structure not identified); ordinary growth, not a defect.
